name: v10.22.18 Europe evidence tranche 1E - RO, BG, LU, MK, RS
notes: Official-source evidence for Romania (RO), Bulgaria (BG), Luxembourg (LU), North Macedonia (MK) and Serbia (RS). All five endpoints were locally probed from the API container and returned HTTPS 200 responses with usable immigration, residence, citizenship, border-control or foreigner-related content. The tranche is intentionally limited to the narrow service functions described and does not claim complete immigration-law coverage. Submission creates pending proposals only; independent reviewer certification remains required.

immigration_assessment.evidence_title: Romanian Ministry of Internal Affairs official portal
immigration_assessment.rationale: The Romanian Ministry of Internal Affairs operates mai.gov.ro as the official portal for internal affairs, border management, immigration and citizenship services. This supports a proposal that Romania directly administers the relevant immigration services through the Ministry of Internal Affairs.
immigration_assessment.review_notes: Approved by coverage-evidence-reviewer. Official source probed and returned HTTPS 200 with relevant immigration/residence/border content.

source_certification.evidence_notes: Locally probed on 2026-07-18 with status local_probe_passed. The Romanian Ministry of Internal Affairs portal returned HTTPS 200 with content about internal affairs, border management, immigration and citizenship services. Keep the initial certification limited to the services explicitly described.
source_certification.review_notes: Approved by coverage-evidence-reviewer. Official source reachable and relevant to immigration/border services.
